correctness.rationale: Conditional involution factorial ratio verified by direct counting; all 43 marked partial patterns were symbolically enumerated into seven position-independent polynomial coefficients, which simplify exactly to the claimed joint probability/covariance. A real strictly decreasing cubic gives the unique sign threshold and asymptotic coefficient cancellation. Independently, all classes of involutions n=4..10 pass 618 exact checks. Boundary k=n has zero covariance, not negative.
